title: Predict the output, then prove it

tests.name: exact output
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.main(new String[0]));
CjTestBase.checkEq(out, "A\nBCD\nE\n", "mixed print/println output");
tests.hint: print glues text onto one line; println ends the line. Expected: A on line 1, BCD on line 2, E on line 3.
